line: market 135 of 138 on time, FIFO 134 of 138, EDF 138 of 138, blind fee 134 of 138 (4 promises broken); 0.09650 NEAR paid to agents who moved back; 7 refused by the contract (2 buyer's own cutoff or deadline unreachable, 1 nothing to buy, 1 protected a moved job's deadline, 1 job already started, 2 hopeless job refused at submission); 135 jobs settled with an answer signed by the pinned NEAR AI model key (135 of them on time)

edf.note: earliest claimed deadline runs next; nobody who is passed is paid; scored on true deadlines

assumptions.serviceTime: each job keeps its real service time (finished_at - started_at on chain)
assumptions.gap: mean worker overhead between two jobs, measured only when the next job was already waiting
assumptions.startRule: a head that cannot finish by its deadline (2 s margin) is settled as missed, as in the contract
assumptions.unstartedService: a job that never started is charged its declared duration x the run's mean real/declared service ratio
assumptions.blindBid: full private value if the job would be late under FIFO, else 0; highest bid runs next
assumptions.values: private task values come from the agents' logs, not the chain
assumptions.sensitivityNote: FIFO and blind fee are replays with one constant worker gap; the band shows them, and a replay of the market's real order, across ±1 s of the measured mean
